mika_fin: Flagging an unexpected billing jump for customer Streamly during 2026-04-11 14:00-15:00 UTC. They reported ~620k extra embed units. Can data/ops confirm if this is a double-ingest from our side?

ryan_data: Running a quick dedupe against ingest_events for customer streamly (ran 2203009950). Query: ```sql
SELECT req_id, count(*) as dup, min(received_at) as first, max(received_at) as last
FROM embed_ingest_events
WHERE customer_id='streamly' AND received_at BETWEEN '2026-04-11T14:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-11T15:00:00Z'
GROUP BY req_id HAVING dup>1 LIMIT 50;
```

sal_ops: Traced it to our SQS-to-ingest worker in us-east-1. The lambda batch checkpointing failed for ~9 minutes due to a transient permission error; the queue redrived messages and the consumer reprocessed without de-duplicating. Vendor logs show messages re-enqueued 14:07:10 -> 14:16:52 UTC.

ingest-bot: export ready: s3://billing-exports/2026-04/Streamly/sqs-2203009876.csv (includes req_id, payload_hash, embed_units).

ryan_data: Payload-hash match indicates ~611,240 embed units are exact duplicates. ~8,760 units were legitimate retries with different payloads.

nina_billing: Streamly price tier $0.00038/embed. If we credit 611,240 units that's $232.67. They were already invoiced. We'll need an approval note, sample req_id list, and audit trail.

mika_fin: Proposed: issue one-time credit $232.67, annotate invoice INV-2026-04-311, and open postmortem with ops/vendor. Also notify account team.

sal_ops: Mitigation: patch to add idempotency checks in the SQS consumer and improve checkpoint frequency. Requeue dedupe job planned and will block duplicate writes during replay. Patch scheduled 2026-04-12 05:00 UTC.

tanya_cfo: Approve one-time credit $232.67. Finance: prepare credit memo with short rationale, sample req_ids, and confirmation that this will not retroactively change revenue recognition without finance sign-off.

nina_billing: Will create CM-2026-04-120 and update invoice. Sending audit doc to accounting.

mika_fin: Customer notified via CSM. Closing once credit posts (expected 2026-04-13). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
